buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable

and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 11.. The Service provider shall provide outsourcing service of Data Entry Operators for data entry/typ ing work, Peons and Cleaning Staff in the office of Administrative Officer/ DDO O/o Pr. CIT(AU)-1, A lwar. The personnel deployed should be well experienced, trained adequately and of sound health . They should be disciplined and well mannered. The scope of work and work allocation for contractual employees are separately mentioned in Scope or work and work allocation' document at Gem portal. 22.. This office will provide the list of offices where service is required to the service provider. The number may exceed/differ from the initial requirement. The deployed persons will perform duty as mentioned in scope of work and will normally work daily between 9.30 A.M. to 6.00 P.M. with half hour lunch during 1.30 P.M to 2.00 P.M on all working days and on such other days as may be spe cified by this office from time to time. In case so required, some/ all workers can be asked to work on declared holidays/ Saturday/Sunday, for which they will be paid as per existing rates issued by the Chief Labor Commissioner, New Delhi. 33.. Each Officer, in whose office the service provider deploys services persons will mark the daily att endance of the service persons, and on the last working day of the month will provide the attenda nce of the deployed persons to the Administrative Officer/ DDO O/o Pr. CIT(AU)-1, Alwar for onwar d transmission to the service provider. 44.. The service provider, on the basis of daily attendance register, will submit the bills on the first w orking day of the succeeding month in this office. At the time of submission of bill, the service pro vider shall submit the proof of the payment made to the personnel and towards statutory liabilitie s, like PF, ESI, Service Tax, etc.

55.. An office of the service provider should be located in the city of consignee i.e Jaipur & Alwar (Raj asthan) and a designated officer should be there who may be contacted in any exigency. 66.. The service provider shall pay charges of manpower at daily rates, as quoted in its tender bid, on the basis of attendance verified by the officers with whom the personnel are deployed. 77.. The wages to be paid to each deployed service person shall be in accordance with the Minimum Wages Act, in coordination with Chief Labor Commissioner (C), New Delhi's latest orders. All existi ng statutory regulations of both the State as well as the Central Governments, shall be adhered by the Service Provider and all records maintained thereof shall be available for scrutiny by this offic e. Any failure to comply with any of the above regulations or any deficiency in service will render t his contract liable for immediate termination without any prior notice. 88.. Payment to the service provider will be made by Account transfer only, on presentation of the bil l. TDS shall be deducted at source as per the rated in Income Tax Act. The service provider would also ensure payments of wages to the service persons so deployed by 7th of each succeeding mo nth and furnish the certificate that the payment has been credited into the bank account of the pe rsonnel's as well as PF/ESI etc. have been deposited. 99.. The personnel shall be punctual and shall complete the work assigned to them promptly and met iculously. The service provider will ensure that all the service persons deployed by it are polite an d courteous with the officers and officials. Any complaint regarding the behavior, etc. will adversel y be looked upon and the service provider may take action against the erring service persons und er intimation to this office. The service provider will ensure that its service persons do not solicit a ny tips etc. from the visitor/officers. In the interest of efficiency and better service, the service pro vider would give a monthly report on the work/ behavior of each service person to this office. 1100. . In case any deployed service person has not reported for work within 30 minutes of the reporting time, the service provider shall immediately make alternative arrangements and provide substitut e persons against the absentee one. In case of failure in providing substitute persons, a penalty sh ould be equal to wages rate per person per day shall be levied on the service provider. However, i n case of agreed leave by deployed person with the permission of the officer in charge, no penalty shall be levied. The personnel, if not found working satisfactorily, must be replaced by the service provider. 1111. . That in case any service person meets with any casualty during working hours, the Administrativ e Officer/ DDO O/o Pr. CIT(AU)-1, Alwar shall also help the service provider for providing first aid m edical assistance to the injured but all the expenses will be borne by the service provider. Insuran ce cover protecting the claims applicable under the Workmen's compensation Act, 1948 shall be t aken by the service provider. The service provider shall arrange necessary insurance cover for an y persons deployed by him even for short duration. This office shall not entertain any claim arisin g out of mishap, if any that may take place. In the event of any liability/ claim falling on this office, same shall be reimbursed/ indemnified by the service provider. 1122. . The Contractor/ Service provider shall indemnify and keep this office indemnified against all acts of omission, negligence, dishonestly or misconduct of the personnel engaged and this office shall not be liable for any damages or compensation to any personnel or third party. All damages cause d by the personnel to the property of the Office shall be recovered from the service provider. 1133. . The service persons of the service provider would for no purpose be considered as employees of t he Income tax department and there would be no liability of the Govt. The persons engaged by th e Contracting Agency/ Service provider will be in the employment of the Agency/ Service provider only. Department/ office will not involve in any dispute between the service provider and workers of the service provider. The existing personnel have been working in this office for the las t many years and are well experienced. Therefore, this office desires to retain such per sonnel and preference may be given to these personnel. The preference for retaining t he present workers has been also put on GeM portal, with the prior approval of the co mpetent authority. 1144. . No other person except Service Provider's authorized representatives shall be allowed to enter th e offices. 1155. . The service provider will be given this agreement for one year period starting from bid awarded t o completion of contract. This agreement can be extended subject to mutual agreement of both t he parties, and if satisfactory services are provided by the service provider. 1166. . The service provider will not be allowed the premature termination of the agreement unless an a dvance notice of one month is given to the Administrative Officer/ DDO O/o Pr. CIT(AU)-1, Alwar. T

his office is empowered to cancel the agreement at any time after giving 30 days’ notice to the se rvice provider. 1177. . Any matter during the period of the agreement which has not been specifically covered by this a greement shall be decided by the O/o Pr. CIT- (AU)-1, Alwar whose decision shall be final and conc lusive. 1188. . In case of any contradiction on any issue in the Terms & Conditions laid down at GeM and in Addi tional Terms & conditions (document uploaded on GeM by this office), the clause mentioned in the Additional terms and conditions laid down by the Administrative Officer/ DDO O/o Pr. CIT(AU)-1, Al war, will be final. 1199. . The Service provider should have 3 years' experience of supplying the service person nel in Income Tax Department or other Government offices. 2200. . The GST number of service provider should be in the state of Rajasthan only. 2211. . In case of any dispute, the jurisdiction of Jaipur courts will apply. 2222. . Bidders not participating in the pre-bid interaction will be disqualified on technical basis. 2233. . For billing and compliance purposes, The Bidder must have a valid GST registration in the State of Rajasthan. 2244. . The bidder must mandatorily upload valid EPF and ESI registration certificates along with a non-bl acklisting self-declaration on their official letterhead. Bids failing to provide these documents will be summarily rejected. 2255. . The personnel deployed shall maintain strict confidentiality of the data and official working of the Income Tax Department. Any breach of data security will result in immediate termination of the c ontract and legal action. 26. 27. 28. 29. 30. 31. 3226. .
